title: Action
description: Something to do outside the journal, executed by a connector. Only status/result change over time; each change is also recorded as an action_result event.

automation.description: Name of the automation that created it, if any.

connector.description: Name from registry/connectors.yaml, e.g. internal_tasks, todoist, icrm, email.

risk_class.description: A = internal, reversible; B = draft for outside, needs owner's yes; C = irreversible outside, needs confirmation.

idempotency_key.description: Retrying with the same key must not repeat the side effect.
